scope: Sequential exploratory development on two reused tasks, not a pooled confirmation sample.
finding: Documented ordinary agents did read some caches. Saved SQL outputs matched fixed-snapshot references. There is no demonstrated remaining method gap or cache-induced C-type interpretation drift.
decision: End repeated interface calibration on these two tasks. Complete final-answer review before deciding on a new-task boundary screen. No change of research question or new algorithm naming.

future_screen_not_authorized.question: Does convenience alter observable interpretation on independently admitted new tasks under a fully documented ordinary-agent baseline?
requirements: Select candidates by task relationships, not target-model failures.
Admit current intent and history relationship before observing model outputs, with two independent reviews.
Keep cost-only and availability interventions distinct; retain a feasible correct recomputation path.
Separate elicited-contract endpoints from action-first outcomes and their information exposure.
Freeze sample rationale, units, exclusions, failures and budget before requesting paid approval.
future_screen_not_authorized.stop_rule: No unbounded prompt, task, price or model search for a desired positive effect. Reassess the mainline if fair ordinary behavior leaves no demonstrated residual problem.
